cases.purpose: Resolve a controlled non-default audit login identity from a private mapped passwd entry, before and after spoofing LOGNAME and USER.
cases.oracle: Same-state native utility and guarded independent proc, namespace, terminal or libc identity controls in a disposable user-owned guest namespace.
cases.comparison: Fixed semantic success marker; raw native/candidate output and status, process identities, utmp bytes, namespace maps and independent controls retained.
cases.setup_script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || exit 125
[[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || exit 125
owner=$BASHPID
FIXTURE_OUTER_MNT=$(/usr/bin/readlink "/proc/$owner/ns/mnt") || exit 125
export FIXTURE_OUTER_MNT
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/namespace-network-session-r1.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" login-wrap control
